runs.text: Read the distance in kilometres and the speed in kilometres per hour, in that order, and show how many minutes the trip takes, rounding up. The program shows only the number.

hints.text: By hand: 10 kilometres at 15 per hour, how many hours is that? And how many minutes?
An hour has 60 minutes. Fill in the card with that relation.

runs.text: Show the result as hours and minutes: with 25 kilometres at 15 per hour,
Frequent mistake: dividing first and multiplying by 60 afterwards, which gives the same here but piles up decimals. Another: rounding the hours before converting to minutes.
